|game_text=Deploy on table. During each player's deploy phase, that player must choose to either deploy a location or lose 1 Force. Effect canceled if any player deploys three or more locations in a single turn.
|joke=The title is the estate agents' rule "location, location, location", in print since a 1926 ''Chicago Tribune'' property advertisement, and the lore is Yoda defending his swamp home: "Mudhole? Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251010080717/https://www.nytimes.com/2009/06/28/magazine/28FOB-onlanguage-t.html Internet Archive], 10 October 2025.</ref><ref name="imsdb-esb">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-The-Empire-Strikes-Back.html Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back script], IMSDb.
